output.objection: You are treating my manual risk assessment as a free concession when it is actually a hard trade off for the automated data contracts. I need the record to show that I accepted the manual process only because the governance on the data side is now fully automated.
output.correction: I did not agree to skip the security review, I agreed to do the risk assessment by hand so we could ship the automated data contracts on time. Do not file this as a reduction in scope, it is a specific trade off between manual governance and automated data flow.
